title: A worker verification's test shards run on ready hosts while a merge trial starts
description: A worker's host-run test check over a large test list, with two ready compute hosts reached through graphyard-host-shim under a strict heavy-job cap of one. Its shards run on both hosts as a merge trial's do, and it holds no heavy-job slot while they run there, so a merge trial takes the one slot at once. Master status's remoteShards shows the worker verification as the latest run, with every shard run remotely and both hosts ready.

steps.name: Run a worker verification on two fake hosts and start a merge trial beside it
